description: Utility functions for handling cache settings form, including grouping fields by category, determining field visibility, and gathering form values based on DOM elements.

methods.name: shouldShowField
methods.description: Determines if a form field should be shown based on its redis_type and the selected redisType.

methods.name: getFieldByName
methods.description: Finds and returns a field object from an array of fields by its field_name.

methods.name: groupFieldsByCategory
methods.description: Groups fields into categories such as basic, ssl, cache management, gcp, and redis type-specific groups.

methods.name: gatherFormValues
methods.description: Collects form values from DOM elements based on field definitions and redisType, returning an object of key-value pairs.
